## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes or relates to.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Automated Test addition / update (Selenium / TestNG)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Unit & integration migrations verified (`npm run db:migrate`)
- [ ] Automated QA tests execute cleanly (`npm run test:automation`)
- [ ] Visual demonstration passes (`mvn test -Dtest=LiveDemoTest -Dheadless=false`)
